name: The First Cub
storyline:
The First is a member of an alien race called the "Bipterra", who was exiled from his tribe and rescued by a pair of scientists to test on him. Their motives seem unknown, whats only certain for The First is that they can't waste this chance.

Find out the truth behind the Bipterra and the E.G.
summary: The First Cub is a 2D platformer with a great storytelling focus and varied gameplay that tries to push the limits of the Pico-8 engine.
